The Ethernet State Manager shall provide an abstract interface to the AUTOSAR Communication Manager to startup or shutdown the communication on an Ethernet cluster.

The Ethernet State Manager does not directly access the Ethernet hardware (Ethernet Communication Controller and Ethernet Transceiver), but by means of the Ethernet Interface. The Ethernet Interface redirects the request to the appropriate driver module.
The EthSM needs to report development errors if development errors are enabled by configuration. Therefore, it includes the header file Det.h.
The EthSM implementation (EthSM.c) references the API of the EthIf. Therefore, it includes the header file EthIf.h.
The EthSM module shall include the ComM_Bus _SM.h head er file.
The EthSM shall provide to the ComM an API, which can be used by the ComM to request communication modes of Ethernet networks.
Depending on the parameters handed over by this API, the Eth SM shall execute a state transition of the related network mode state machine (refer to section 7.6).
This transition shall translate the request into a respective API call to control the assigned Ethernet peripherals.
The EthSM shall provide an API, which can be polled by the ComM to get the current communication mode of an Ethernet network.
The EthSM shall use a call-back notification of ComM to notify ComM of a change in communication modes.
Depending on the network mode state machine, the EthSM shall control the Ethernet Interface Controller modes of each Ethernet network.
The EthSM shall use the API of the EthIf to control the operating modes of the assigned Ethernet Interface Controllers.
The EthSM shall implement for each configured network handle one network mode state machine (EthSM statemachine).
After the initialization of the EthSM the state machine shall have a transition to ETHSM_STATE_OFFLINE.

Transition from OFFLINE to WAIT_TRCVLINK In the state ETHSM_STATE_OFFLINE the state machine shall have a transition to ETHSM_ STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK, if ComM requests for the corresponding network handle: COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION or COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION_WITH_ WAKEUP_REQUEST and EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE

The EthSM statemachine shall consist of 2 main states: ETHSM_FULL_COMMUNICATION and ETHSM_NO_COMMUNICATION.
The ETHSM_FULL_COMMUNICATION shall have 3 sub-states: ETHSM_STATE_OFFLINE, ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK and ETHSM_ STATE_WAIT_ONLINE.
The ETHSM_NO_COMMUNICATION shall have 3 sub-states: ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE, ETHSM_STATE_ONHOLD and ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ OFFLINE.

Self transition WAIT_TRCVLINK If EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and the EthSM statmachine is in state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_TRCVLINK, and ComM request now COMM_FULL_ COMMUNICATION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.

Self transition WAIT_ONLINE If EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and EthSM is in state ETHSM_STATE_WAIT_ONLINE and ComM requests now COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then EthSM shall request the corresponding EthIfCtrl with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.

Self transition STATE_ONLINE If the EthSM statemachine is in state ETHSM_STATE_ONLINE, EthSMWakeupSleepOnDatalineEnabled is set to TRUE and ComM request COMM_FULL_COMMUNICATION_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST, then the controller mode of the corresponding EthIfCtrl shall be requested with ETH_MODE_ACTIVE_WITH_WAKEUP_REQUEST.
